newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Kalamazoo says businesses perform well.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Kalamazoo says businesses perform well.

text.p: Building materials and office supplies group Kalamazoo Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday its businesses had performed well and in line with an ambitious earnings budget for the 1996/97 (July-June) financial year.

"Overall sales have been soft and marginally below budget, but profitwise this has been offset by higher margins reflecting the strong emphasis which the company has placed on margin management over the past year," Kalamazoo chairman Trevor Eastwood told the company's annual general meeting.
Eastwood said Kalamazoo's electrical products group had performed overall in line with budget, although some divisions were slightly below budget, but ahead of last year.
"Below budget sales have been more than offset by higher margins, and, as a result, consolidated earnings for the electrical products group are ahead of budget," he said.

Printing group sales had been below budget, reflecting weak trading conditions, but were offset by higher margins due to cost constraints adopted by the company over the past year and, as result, earnings are ahead of budget, Eastwood said.

"Assuming no deterioration in current trading conditions, we are on track to improve on the proforma EBITA (earnings before interest, tax and depreciation and amortisation) of A$22 million advised to shareholders in the 1996 annual report and the A$11.8 million of net profit after tax achieved for the 1996 financial year," Eastwood said.

He said that based on the company's policy of substantially paying out all franking credits achievement of the budget should enable the company to pay a dividend in the range of 18 to 20 cents per share for the 1997 financial year.
